name: 雷电（防护/等级/检测）标准

map.🔍 建筑物防雷分类与保护范围计算: 🔍 Building Lightning Protection Classification and Protection Range Calculation
map.根据建筑物用途与年预计雷击次数判定防雷类别，使用滚球半径法计算避雷针保护范围，并: Determine the lightning protection class from the building's use and the expected annual number of lightning strikes, use the rolling-sphere method to compute the protection range of a lightning rod, and self-check the compliance of lightning protection facilities.
map.📖 查看「建筑物防雷分类与保护范围计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Building Lightning Protection Classification and Protection Range Calculation User Guide"
map.建筑物防雷：雷击大地密度 Ng=0.1·Td（Td 为雷暴日数）；等效面积 Ae: Building lightning protection: ground flash density Ng=0.1·Td (Td is the number of thunderstorm days); the equivalent area Ae is estimated from the building length L, width W and height h (when h is less than the length and width, Ae=L·W+2(L+W)√(h(200−h))+πh(200−h), otherwise simplified to L·W+2(L+W)h+πh²), in km²; the expected annual number of strikes N=k·Ng·Ae (k is the correction coefficient), and Class I/II/III protection is determined by N and the building's importance. Rolling-sphere protection range: protection radius rx=√(h(2hr−h))−√(hx(2hr−hx)), where hr is the rolling-sphere radius (Class I 30m / Class II 45m / Class III 60m), h is the rod height and hx the protected object height.
map.特殊重要建筑（炸药库/化工/核电）: Specially important buildings (explosives depot / chemical / nuclear power)
map.当地年平均雷暴日 Td（d/a）: Local annual mean thunderstorm days Td (d/a)
map.年预计雷击次数 N = k×Ng×Ae；Ng≈0.1×Td；Ae为等效面积: Expected annual number of lightning strikes N = k×Ng×Ae; Ng≈0.1×Td; Ae is the equivalent area
map.防雷分类依据 GB 50057《建筑物防雷设计规范》: Classification follows GB 50057 "Code for Design of Lightning Protection of Buildings"
map.一类防雷滚球半径30m，二类45m，三类60m: Rolling-sphere radius: Class I 30m, Class II 45m, Class III 60m
map.年预计雷击次数 N≥0.05次/a 的建筑需设防雷装置: Buildings with an expected annual strike count N≥0.05 /a need lightning protection devices
map.滚球法适用于避雷针/线保护范围计算: The rolling-sphere method applies to the protection-range calculation of lightning rods/wires
map.清点应装防雷装置点数与已合规点数算合规率。: Count the required lightning protection points and the compliant ones to compute the compliance rate.
map.按合规率评合格/基本合格/需整改。: Grade as qualified / basically qualified / needs rectification by the compliance rate.
map.年度安检跟踪整改进度。: Track rectification progress through annual inspections.
map.应检 20 处、合规 18 处 → 合规率=18/20×100=90%，评级「合: 20 points to inspect, 18 compliant → compliance rate = 18/20×100=90%, rated "qualified" (≥90%).
map.合规率 75–89% 基本合格、60–74% 需整改、<60% 不合格；某楼 7: Compliance rate 75-89% basically qualified, 60-74% needs rectification, <60% unqualified; a building at 70% falls into needs-rectification and must install the rest within a deadline.
map.防雷检测多久一次？: How often is lightning protection inspected?
map.爆炸危险场所每半年、其他建筑每年一次，雷雨季前必检。: Every half year for explosive-hazard sites and once a year for other buildings, always before the thunderstorm season.
map.总体合格但仍可能有单点隐患，不合格点须闭环整改而非只看均值为安。: Overall qualified but single-point hazards may remain; non-compliant points must be closed-loop rectified rather than judging safety by the average.
map.关于「建筑物防雷分类与保护范围计算」: About the "Building Lightning Protection Classification and Protection Range Calculation"
map.建筑物防雷分类与保护范围计算工具，支持年预计雷击次数计算与防雷分类判定、滚球半径: A building lightning protection classification and protection range calculation tool supporting three functions: expected annual strike count and protection classification, rolling-sphere lightning rod protection range calculation, and lightning protection facility compliance self-check.
map.年预计雷击次数 N 自动计算（GB 50057）: Automatic expected annual strike count N (GB 50057)
map.滚球半径法保护范围计算（不同高度保护半径）: Rolling-sphere protection range calculation (protection radius at different heights)
